author: sonnet
label: climb-04-01
changes: Removed the duplicate plain arrow from Outcome? to PAYMENT_DECLINED; the decline now travels only as the event PaymentDeclined.
Create-order box now gets the cart first, says what happens if Cart fails (no order, try again), and replies with the order id at once.
How to read now explains that the customer's page polls Order for status and that Order sends all emails, with failed emails retried and harmless.

Added an Order sweep that cancels orders stuck in PENDING_RESERVATION for over 5 minutes as CANCELLED_TIMEOUT and sends ReleaseStock; added the status and a failure note; the 5 minutes is listed as an open point.
Gave the 'order no longer waiting' arrow an explicit RefundRequested trigger and added: a CONFIRMED order ignores a repeated success, so it is never refunded.
Webhook handling now finds the payment record by the order id reference and writes the outcome event to the outbox in the same transaction.
Stated that the expiry sweep does not tell Order, and that release does nothing when no hold exists.
Added Cart-failure and Inventory-never-answers notes, outbox redelivery for cart emptying, and 'no such charge counts as declined' for the lost-webhook check.
Defined attemptId in How to read and put it in the Order box, stores table and double-click note, replacing the vague 'cart's checkout attempt'.
Added a note and diagram text for charge request errors: retry a few times with the same key, order stays AWAITING_PAYMENT.
Stated that a payment slower than 10 minutes always cancels and refunds, as intended.
Moved Lost webhook into its own note, naming Payment as owner of a one-minute sweep, and said the page shows 'waiting for payment' meanwhile.
Added a customer message and diagram arrow for CANCELLED_TIMEOUT, and said late StockShort is ignored too.
Explained event ids and handled-id storage in the same transaction, and added them to the Inventory box and stores table.
Refund box now says amount comes from the snapshot, the charge id comes from the payment record, and a non-SUCCEEDED record does nothing; added charge id to Payment stores.
Merged the 'Order of events' rule into How to read and shortened it in Other protections; added the charge retry count to open points.
Reordered into newcomer layout: summary, terms, stores table, diagram, statuses, numbered steps, failure table, open questions.
Replaced 'How to read this' with a 3-paragraph summary plus a terms list; merged the outbox, inbox and status-ignoring rules into short term definitions.
Merged the duplicate-handling explanation (previously in the reading notes, the Duplicate webhooks note and Other protections) into the inbox term and step 4.
Removed the 'Other protections' section; its three items (double click, retried charge, event order) were already covered by attemptId, the idempotency key and the inbox/status checks.
Merged 'Late success after the hold lapsed' and 'Success for an order no longer waiting' into the failure table, shortened wording.
Removed the 'Never touches' column of the stores table (implied by the no-shared-tables rule).
Turned the per-branch failure notes into nine numbered steps, each with starts, does, keeps and if-it-goes-wrong, plus one failure table.
Merged the cart-only-on-confirmation note into step 9 and the last table row.
Kept the Mermaid diagram and statuses unchanged.
